Select the first 500 exact activity measurements for compounds tested against thyroid hormone receptor CHEMBL1862. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and join target_dictionary on tid to filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1862. Require exact measurements by filtering where standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null. Join compound_structures as an inner join on molregno to include canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, and standard_units. Sort rows by potency ascending (standard_value). Do not deduplicate; keep all qualifying activity rows.
